bellyPattern.label: Belly pain pattern
bellyPattern.text: Belly pain often shows up around {{time}}. A belly massage may help.
bellyPattern.count: Belly pain was logged in this window on {{count}} of the last {{recent}} days.
bellyPattern.rule: The suggestion shows when that happens on at least {{minimum}} of the last {{recent}} days and on at least {{coverage}}% of the days with belly pain in the last {{lookBack}} days.
bellyPattern.disclaimer: This is a pattern from what you logged, not medical advice. If the pain keeps coming back, mention it to your pediatrician.

overtired.label: Witching hour heads-up
overtired.text: Witching hour soon: awake for {{awake}}, usually fussy after about {{limit}}. A nap soon may help.
overtired.limit: Usual longest comfortable awake time: about {{duration}}.
overtired.rule: About {{percentile}}% of the {{count}} daytime awake stretches below lasted this long or less (from the end of one sleep to the start of the next, starting between {{dayStart}} and {{dayEnd}} in the last {{lookBack}} days; at least {{minimum}} are needed). The note shows from {{lead}} min before that time until {{grace}} min after it.
overtired.disclaimer: This is a pattern from what you logged, not medical advice. If the crying worries you, talk to your pediatrician.

fussyPattern.label: Fussy time pattern
fussyPattern.text: Fussiness often starts around {{time}}. A calm routine may help.
fussyPattern.count: A fussy spell was logged in this window on {{count}} of the last {{recent}} days.
fussyPattern.rule: The suggestion shows when that happens on at least {{minimum}} of the last {{recent}} days and on at least {{coverage}}% of the days with a fussy spell in the last {{lookBack}} days.
fussyPattern.disclaimer: This is a pattern from what you logged, not medical advice. If the crying worries you, mention it to your pediatrician.

diaper.afterFeedExpected: The last feed ended at {{time}}: a dirty diaper usually follows between {{start}} and {{end}}.
diaper.afterFeedLag_one: After a feed, a dirty diaper came about {{median}} min after it ended (usually {{lower}} to {{upper}} min), from {{count}} dirty diaper with a feed in the {{hours}} hours before.
diaper.afterFeedLag_other: After a feed, a dirty diaper came about {{median}} min after it ended (usually {{lower}} to {{upper}} min), from {{count}} dirty diapers with a feed in the {{hours}} hours before.
diaper.wetRule: A wet diaper is one logged as wet or mixed. The estimate needs at least {{minimum}} wet diapers in the last {{days}} days; the window is the middle half of the gaps between them ({{lower}}th to {{upper}}th percentile), and recent days count more. The note shows from {{lead}} min before the expected time until {{grace}} min after it.
diaper.dirtyRule: A dirty diaper is one logged as dirty or mixed. From the gaps: at least {{minimum}} dirty diapers in the last {{days}} days. After feeds: at least {{pairs}} dirty diapers with a feed in the {{hours}} hours before, and the middle half of those times at most {{spread}} min wide. The note shows from {{lead}} min before the expected time until {{grace}} min after it.
diaper.wetDrop: Wet diapers in the last 24 hours: {{recent}}, fewer than usual (about {{usual}} a day). If that continues, mention it to your pediatrician.
diaper.disclaimer: This is a pattern from what you logged, not medical advice.
